module_summary: Stream crossbar: per-input demuxes route valid/ready by sel_i onto a cross matrix, per-output round-robin arbiter trees pick one input and pass data plus source index through optional spill registers.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Per-input valid, demuxed toward selected output

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Per-input ready from demux, granted by output arbiter

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload broadcast to all output arbiters

anchors.name: sel_i
anchors.why: Selects destination output port for each input

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Per-output downstream ready into spill register

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Output payload deaggregated from spill register

anchors.name: idx_o
anchors.why: Index of input that won arbitration for this output

anchors.name: rr_i
anchors.why: External round-robin priority per output arbiter

anchors.name: clr_i
anchors.why: Synchronous clear of arbiters and spill registers

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Transposed request vector into each output arbiter

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Arbiter grant vector routed back to input demux readies

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Input data replicated across all outputs for arbiter mux

anchors.name: gen_outs[*].arb
anchors.why: Arbiter-selected data and index bundle into spill register

anchors.name: gen_outs[*].arb_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter output request into spill register

anchors.name: gen_outs[*].arb_ready
anchors.why: Spill register ready back to arbiter grant

anchors.name: gen_outs[*].spill
anchors.why: Spill register output bundle driving data_o and idx_o

groups.name: Input demuxes
groups.description: Per-input demux routing valid/ready to selected output

groups.name: Crossbar switch matrix
groups.description: Transposes input/output handshake and data matrices

groups.name: Output arbiters
groups.description: Per-output round-robin arbiter tree selecting an input

groups.name: Output spill registers
groups.description: Optional spill register stage per output, deaggregates data and index
